capabilities.capability: A frozen cross-board evaluation population and held-out sample make discovery quality measurable without swapping difficult subjects.
capabilities.before_limitation: No fixed denominator existed, so improvements could only be shown with attractive examples.
steps: Read the served cohort.
Confirm the recorded seed, selection hash and 59-board enumeration.
Confirm no fixed dossier subject is in the held-out sample and every judgment predates tuning.
capabilities.relation_assertion: Held-out subjects are selected by the recorded seed per board and judged before tuning.
capabilities.negative_assertion: None of the six fixed dossier histories is counted in the held-out sample.

capabilities.capability: Official CEQR, DOT and EDC documents named by the fixed dossier are retained with hashes and dated locators, or retained as acquisition failures.
capabilities.before_limitation: Only the original neighborhood had retained official evidence.
steps: Read the served document observations.
Confirm every observation belongs to a fixed family and a dossier host.
Confirm retained documents carry hashes and failures carry reasons.
capabilities.relation_assertion: Each retained document carries its publisher hash and located source span.
capabilities.negative_assertion: No document outside the fixed dossier hosts is retained or substituted for a failed acquisition.
unresolved_limits: 8 of 12 fixed dossier documents are retained as acquisition failures; the affected proofs stay open and no substitute source was sought.

capabilities.capability: Typed, source-backed relations connect proposals, proceedings, corridors and components while every identity stays separate.
capabilities.before_limitation: Related applications, cases and phases could not be traversed without merging them.
steps: Read the served relations.
Confirm each expected dossier relation is admitted.
Confirm every negative control is retained as a rejection and no identity is merged.

capabilities.capability: Documented participants keep source-specific roles and dates without inventing ownership or formal board positions.
capabilities.before_limitation: Participation was either absent or implied by a repeated label.
steps: Read the served role observations.
Confirm Franklin applicant roles and the Lighthouse Point chair statement.
Confirm no formal board action or recorded ownership is admitted.
capabilities.relation_assertion: applicant_of for C200184ZMK and C230356ZMK; a chair statement about Lighthouse Point.
capabilities.negative_assertion: A chair quote, a DOT presentation or testimony is never a formal board action; a shared applicant spelling is never recorded ownership.
unresolved_limits: Role strata not documented by the fixed dossier remain missing: formal_board_action, recorded_owner, sponsor.

capabilities.capability: Reproducible as-of states separate planned, decided and realized events and keep component scope.
capabilities.before_limitation: A forecast, a partial opening and a preliminary measurement could read as the same kind of event.
steps: Read the served temporal artifact.
Confirm the Kingsbridge 2018 operation stays a planned forecast.
Confirm the Lighthouse Point opening does not close the project and 31st Avenue results stay preliminary.
capabilities.relation_assertion: Franklin proposal epochs, Kingsbridge proposal epochs, Lighthouse Point component status and 31st Avenue periods are comparable as-of states.
capabilities.negative_assertion: The anticipated 2018 Kingsbridge operation is never shown as an opening; a first-phase opening never closes the whole project.
unresolved_limits: No retained dated comparison exists for coyle and sixth-avenue; that outcome is reported rather than filled.

capabilities.capability: Every admitted parcel is served through a generation-checked manifest reader.
capabilities.before_limitation: The reader loaded one shard and selected only the first parcel.
steps: Read the served manifest.
Read every shard it declares.
Confirm one generation and that the reader traverses every declared parcel.
capabilities.relation_assertion: The manifest generation equals every shard generation and the parcel count equals the traversed parcels.
capabilities.negative_assertion: A mixed-generation shard is never read as a successful history.
unresolved_limits: The parcel population receipt is incomplete; strata without a published population: coyle, franklin-avenue, lighthouse-point, sixth-avenue, thirty-first-avenue.
The scheduled parcel-history materialization has not yet been observed after deployment.

capabilities.capability: Search exposes each fixed history with dated events, official sources, a continuation and working Back navigation.
capabilities.before_limitation: A resident could not reach these histories from an address, case or project name.
steps: Open Search with each fixed query at the desktop-keyboard and narrow-touch viewports.
Inspect and dismiss one event, open its official source, return, and follow the continuation.
Repeat with scripting disabled.
capabilities.relation_assertion: Each fixed query renders its own family with at least one dated event and more than one retained identity.
capabilities.negative_assertion: Internal method fields never render, and an unavailable load is never shown as an empty history.
capabilities.destination: Official publisher source and the family continuation link

capabilities.capability: An operator census reports all 59 boards by acquisition and discovery stage against the frozen population.
capabilities.before_limitation: Gaps between boards were invisible, so absence could read as inactivity.
steps: Read the served coverage census.
Confirm every snapshot enumerates 59 boards.
Confirm zero-denominator scores stay not estimable and the civic-activity disclaimer is present.
capabilities.relation_assertion: Each board row separates registry coverage, acquired documents, extractable records, admitted relations and discoverable histories.
capabilities.negative_assertion: Unknown is never measured zero, and no row claims a level of civic activity.
unresolved_limits: Coverage reports retained acquisition and discovery stages only; it does not measure or equalize civic activity between boards and does not claim citywide completeness.
